prompt_md: An office of 365 people has cake on every day that is someone's birthday. Birthdays are random over 365 days. On average, how many cake days are there a year?
prompt_short: 365 staff, cake on every birthday. Average cake days per year?
hint_md: For one day, what's the chance it's nobody's birthday?
explain_intuition_md: 365 people and 365 days suggests a birthday for every day. But birthdays pile up: plenty of days get two or three people while others get none. Any given day has about a 37% chance of being nobody's birthday, so only about 63% of days get cake.
